config.loss: mean per-position KL(target || drafter), full vocabulary, temperature 1
config.positions: all 256 prefixes per chunk; no padding, labels, chat template, or activation matching
config.checkpoint_selection: lowest KL on all 50 validation chunks, including step 0
config.timing: synchronized wall time including prefill and all decode work; both drafters merged/plain

dataset_manifest.sampling: article-balanced; one random window/article, test up to two in separate article halves
limitations: Pilot sizes are a resource budget, not a statistically optimized split.
Long-enough articles only; article-balanced, not token-weighted corpus sampling.
Exact checks do not rule out paraphrases, topic overlap, or pretraining exposure.
Test prompts share articles: aggregate uncertainty by article, not by prompt.
Wikipedia reference continuations are not the target model's generated answers.
